At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the Role

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to own test automation across Artificial's product platform. This is a hands-on technical role: we already have a substantial automated test suite - roughly 680 Playwright tests alone, plus extensive backend coverage - but it's grown quickly without a dedicated owner, and needs real structure, consolidation, and meaningful metrics built on top of it. You'll start on Platform, bringing structure to what exists and establishing standards for what gets added next, then extend automation into Transform/customer-configuration testing over time - an area with no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers, in work that's highly specific to each client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reorganisation and consolidation: Bring coverage, completeness, and integrity to our existing ~680-test Playwright suite (plus extensive backend coverage) - identifying and removing duplication, fixing or removing flaky tests, and establishing clear structure and naming conventions where the suite has outgrown its original organisation

  • Meaningful metrics: Build real, trustworthy metrics off the back of the existing suite - coverage mapped to actual product routes and features (today's closest proxy, Playwright page objects, doesn't map cleanly to routes), pass/fail trends over time, and flaky-test tracking

  • Ongoing addition and maintenance: Own the suite as a living asset, not a one-off clean-up - adding new automated coverage as features ship, maintaining existing tests as the product changes, and keeping the suite healthy on an ongoing basis

  • CI pipeline scaling: The suite has grown 40% in three months (470 to 680 tests) and is now regularly hitting CI resource limits, with an 8-shard stress-test job approaching a 4-hour timeout. Work collaboratively with the QA Lead and Engineering on a real scaling plan for our existing CI pipeline (Buildkite) - this can't just mean adding more runners indefinitely. You'll be closely involved in shaping this, with full ownership expected to grow over time

  • Clarifying automation boundaries: Work with Engineering and FDE teams to establish a clear, documented relationship between platform-level automated tests and FDE "golden tests," removing current ambiguity about what covers what; also align with the performance testing work already underway so load/performance results sit in the same reporting picture rather than a separate silo

  • Mentorship: Support QA Engineers with automation as they need it - helping them write and troubleshoot tests, sharing what you know, and building their confidence over time

  • Reporting integration: Work with the QA Lead to integrate automated test results into the wider test management approach, so a test failure automatically generates a structured bug report linked back to Linear, rather than issues being created manually on an ad-hoc basis as they are today

  • Cross-team collaboration: Work closely with Engineering (who currently own significant existing automation) to agree a clear, documented handover and ongoing collaboration model, avoiding duplicated effort or unclear ownership

  • Building Transform/config automation from scratch: Once Platform is on a solid footing, extend automated coverage into FDE/customer-configuration testing - an area that has no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers. Unlike the Platform work above, this genuinely starts with nothing, in an area that's highly specific to each client rather than standard across the platform

About You

  • Strong hands-on experience building and owning test automation frameworks at scale, not just writing individual automated tests

  • Deep experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, including framework design and CI/CD integration

  • Comfortable working in or around a codebase - reading and reasoning about application code, even if not writing production features yourself

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving flaky or unreliable automated tests, and designing tests to avoid these problems from the start

  • Experience establishing test coverage visibility/reporting from scratch, where none previously existed - you'll use this directly when the role extends into Transform/config automation, which genuinely starts with nothing today

  • A methodical, standards-driven approach - you think about frameworks and patterns, not just individual test cases

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

jobs.title: Expert Data Catalog (f/m/d)
Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)

Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

Engineering Manager - Spain 🇪🇸
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
Suite à une croissance rapide et rentable en France, Doctrine s'est développée en Italie et en Allemagne, puis a racheté Maïté, une legaltech espagnole, au début de l'année 2026. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un·e Engineering Manager pour continuer à améliorer notre IA juridique sur le marché espagnol. 
C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne.
 
À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement.
 
Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github !
 
Bon à savoir : une expérience professionnelle préalable dans le domaine juridique n'est pas requise. En revanche, l'envie de t'investir et de monter en compétence sur la compréhension de documents juridiques est essentielle.

Les missions 🛠
  • Manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire (software engineers, data engineers, machines learning engineers).
  • Motiver ton équipe, l’accompagner dans sa performance, aider tes collaborateurs dans le développement de leurs soft skills (communication, leadership) et les accompagner dans leur évolution de carrière.

  • Construire et maintenir un haut niveau de compréhension des problématiques métiers des membres de ton équipe, au service de ta crédibilité technique au quotidien

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Une première expérience réussie en management d’équipe software ou data
  • Une solide expérience en tant que que senior software engineer (fullstack developer idéalement)
  • Un intérêt marqué pour l’humain, la bienveillance et le leadership
  • Une capacité à partager tes connaissances et tirer tes collègues vers le haut
  • Une bonne maitrise de la langue française
  • Une volonté le temps que l’équipe grandisse d’être “hands on” et de contribuer au code
  • Idéalement, des notions d’espagnol car tu seras amené à manager un équipe qui travaille sur des données en Espagne

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.

jobs.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer

Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

  • Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

  • Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

  • High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

  • Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

  • Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

  • Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

  • You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

  • You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

  • You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer- Data Centers
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer- Data Centers

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online.

We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up across the Americas, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales.

Examples of Problems We're Solving

Validate electrical feasibility before commercial commitment. A site or agreement is only as good as its ability to support the power capacity and distribution infrastructure required to run it. You'll lead electrical due diligence, utility interconnection analysis, and equipment feasibility review to inform Go / No-Go decisions before deals close.

Keep electrical design decisions ahead of development. Coordinate with Site Selection, Development, Engineering, and Delivery so power distribution topology, redundancy strategy, and equipment assumptions are validated early enough to protect schedule and budget once construction begins.

Build a repeatable technical evaluation program. Help establish the standards, design criteria, and technical readiness gates that will support electrical engineering review across every AI infrastructure acquisition in the Americas.

About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you'll provide the technical electrical engineering perspective across the acquisition and development lifecycle — from initial site and deal evaluation through construction readiness. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll partner with Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Development, Energy, Finance, and Delivery to ensure every project's power distribution, utility interconnection, and equipment assumptions are technically sound before they move forward.

This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the technical evaluation standards, design criteria, and readiness gates you'll use are still being written — in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently assess complex electrical infrastructure while helping build the systems that make every future evaluation faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

What You'll Own

  • Lead electrical engineering evaluation of prospective sites, colocation capacity, and build-to-suit opportunities.
  • Own technical assumptions for power distribution topology, capacity, and equipment strategy feeding the pre-construction risk register.
  • Assess utility interconnection, on-site generation, and redundancy strategies (N, N+1, 2N) against site conditions and load requirements.
  • Recommend Go / No-Go input on electrical feasibility as projects advance through key development milestones.
  • Deliver technically validated electrical scope to the Delivery organization with complete documentation and minimized risk.

Technical Due Diligence & Feasibility

  • Lead electrical due diligence on prospective sites, existing facilities, and colocation capacity under evaluation.
  • Evaluate utility capacity, interconnection queue position, substation requirements, and on-site generation/UPS strategy against projected IT load.
  • Assess electrical equipment availability, lead times (transformers, switchgear, generators), and vendor constraints that could affect schedule or capex.
  • Ensure electrical assumptions are fully integrated into project budgets, capacity models, and schedules.

Design & Equipment Strategy

  • Partner with Engineering to define power distribution topology and redundancy strategy appropriate to each site and deal structure.
  • Evaluate EPMS/BMS controls integration and electrical system commissioning requirements early in the acquisition process.
  • Provide technical input on switchgear, UPS, and generator selection, redundancy strategy, and capex trade-offs across candidate sites.
  • Ensure electrical design intent is preserved as deals move from negotiation into development.

Construction Readiness

  • Establish electrical technical readiness criteria as part of project handoff standards.
  • Verify electrical design assumptions, equipment specifications, and capacity commitments are complete before turnover to Delivery.
  • Identify and resolve electrical technical risks before they impact construction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary electrical engineering technical interface across Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Development, Energy, and Delivery.
  • Coordinate with consulting engineers, utility providers, equipment vendors, and commissioning agents to validate executable electrical strategies.
  • Align internal stakeholders and external consultants to prevent technical scope drift as projects move from acquisition into development.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ensure every acquisition is grounded in sound electrical engineering judgment before commercial commitment.
  • Deliver predictable, technically validated power distribution and redundancy strategies across the portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve electrical technical risks before they impact construction.
  • Build trusted relationships with utility providers, equipment vendors, consulting engineers, and commissioning partners.
  • Help build the technical standards and evaluation processes the Infrastructure Acquisition Group runs on as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and building technical evaluation processes where none exist. You know how to independently assess complex electrical infrastructure while helping define how future projects should be evaluated.
  • 8+ years of experience in data center electrical engineering, power systems design, or mission-critical electrical systems.
  • Experience with medium-voltage distribution, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and utility interconnection for high-density AI/hyperscale environments.
  • Strong understanding of electrical capacity planning, redundancy topology (N, N+1, 2N), equipment selection, and capex trade-offs in data center design.
  • Experience evaluating electrical feasibility of sites or facilities prior to commercial commitment.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center or AI infrastructure development.
  • Experience with EPMS/BMS controls integration and electrical systems commissioning.
  • Experience with utility interconnection agreements and interconnection queue strategy.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or similar professional certification.
  • Experience evaluating colocation or build-to-suit electrical infrastructure in a due diligence capacity.

Why Join Nebius

The infrastructure supporting AI is being built now. This is an opportunity to help define how Nebius evaluates and designs the power systems behind every AI infrastructure acquisition while helping build the function itself — the technical standards, design criteria, and evaluation framework that will support infrastructure investments across the Americas. You'll work on some of the industry's largest and most complex AI infrastructure developments while helping shape the physical foundation of the global AI economy.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Senior Expansion Manager:in (m/w/d) für Standortakquise in München
jobs.description:
Senior Expansion Manager:in (m/w/d) für Standortakquise in München

Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen!

Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Süd rund um München verstärken. 

Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit.

Als Pionier im Bereich der Schnellladeinfrastruktur haben wir es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 ein europaweites Netz von über 1.000 Schnellladestationen aufzubauen.

Dafür arbeiten mehr als 500 Kolleg:innen aus über 50 Nationen in zehn Ländern zusammen. Bei Fastned triffst du auf Menschen aus unterschiedlichsten Fachbereichen und Kulturen, die eine gemeinsame Mission verbindet: Wir wollen die Mobilitätswende beschleunigen und Elektromobilität für alle zugänglicher machen.

Ein Job an der Schnittstelle von Immobilien, innovativer Technologie und Nachhaltigkeit

Als Senior Expansion Manager:in entscheidest du mit, wo die nächste Generation unserer Schnellladestationen entsteht. Du identifizierst attraktive Standorte in deiner Region, sprichst Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen und Kommunen an und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften.

Du arbeitest in einer innovativen und schnell wachsenden Branche, in der sich Markt, Technologie und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Dabei verbindest du dein Immobilien- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit einem konkreten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität.

Deine Arbeit hat sichtbare Ergebnisse: Aus deinen Analysen, Gesprächen und Verhandlungen entstehen neue Schnellladestationen, die täglich von Menschen in ganz Deutschland und Europa genutzt werden.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit unseren Teams aus Architektur, Legal, Construction und Operations zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Lösungen, teilt Wissen und bringt neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.

Ausserdem wollen wir in deiner Region ein kleines Team aufbauen, womit sich dir die Chance bietet Verantwortung für juniorigere Teammitglieder zu übernehmen. 

Bei Fastned hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, welches nicht auf etablierte Standards wartet, sondern diese aktiv gestaltet. Elektromobilität und Schnellladeinfrastruktur sind für dich noch neu? Kein Problem. Wir unterstützen dich mit einem umfassenden Onboarding und relevanten Workshops.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der gewerblichen Immobilienwirtschaft, Standortakquise, Projektentwicklung.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Akquise von Standorten oder Immobilien und im Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen oder Kommunen.

  • Du bist erfahren in der Vorbereitung und Führung von Verhandlungen, idealerweise im Zusammenhang mit Pacht-, Miet- oder Kaufverträgen.

  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis dafür, wie Immobilien und Standorte bewertet werden. Dazu gehören beispielsweise Lage, Sichtbarkeit, Erreichbarkeit, Verkehrsanbindung, wirtschaftliche Attraktivität und grundsätzliche Machbarkeit.

  • Du kannst relevante Informationen strukturiert analysieren und daraus eine fundierte Einschätzung oder Empfehlung ableiten. Erfahrung mit Karten-, CRM- oder Analysetools ist von Vorteil.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst sicher und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und bringst deine Projekte aktiv voran.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Du bist bereit das Deutsche Team einmal im Monat in Köln zu besuchen, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen und freust dich auch auf gelegentliche Besuche in unserem Headquarter in Amsterdam

Du musst kein:e Expert:in für Elektromobilität oder technische Immobilienbewertung sein. Wichtig ist, dass du relevante Erfahrung in der Standortakquise mitbringst, wirtschaftliche und praktische Zusammenhänge verstehst und Lust hast, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Wir suchen erfahrene Profile auf Senior-Level. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht nur, was du bereits gemacht hast, sondern vor allem, ob du Dinge gestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit anderen etwas bewegen möchtest.

Deine Benefits

  • 29 Tage Urlaub

  • Zwei Mission Days pro Jahr für gemeinnütziges Engagement oder die Unterstützung unserer Mission

  • Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen

  • Vollelektrischer Firmenwagen inklusive Ladekosten

  • Unternehmensweiter erfolgsabhängiger Bonus

  • Aktienoptionsprogramm

  • 3.000 Euro Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr

  • 25 Prozent Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

  • Mental-Wellbeing-Angebote mit nilo health

  • Bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft

  • Angebote für Frauengesundheit durch unsere Kooperation mit Flouria

  • Persönliches Coaching rund um die Elternzeit durch Foundree

  • Internationales Team, regelmäßige Team Events und europäische Company Trips

  • Die Möglichkeit dich mit deinem regionalen Team in einem zentralen CoWorking Space in München zu treffen. 

Lust, die besten Standorte für die Mobilität von morgen zu sichern?

Bewirb dich einfach und schnell mit deinem Lebenslauf über unser Bewerbungsformular. 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Fastned ist ein Arbeitgeber mit Chancengleichheit. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe, Geschlechter und sexuellen Orientierungen.

jobs.title: Director Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Director Product (m/w/d)
Deine Aufgaben

Unsere Produkte sind der Grund, warum Kund:innen bei uns kaufen und immer wieder zurückkommen. Als Director Product (m/w/d) verantwortest du alles, was dahintersteht, für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group: von der ersten Produktidee über Sourcing und Produktion bis zur Lieferung ins Lager. Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain aber auch Quality Management und ESG sind dein Kern, und genau dort bist du strategisch wie operativ tief drin.

Du setzt die Richtung, führst die Heads und ihre Teams und hältst die Fäden über alle Abteilungen hinweg zusammen. Wenn es darauf ankommt, sitzt du selbst mit am Tisch der Supplier. Kurz: Du bist die Person, die unser Produkt-Business nach vorne bringt, mit Weitblick und mit beiden Händen im Tagesgeschäft.



Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktstrategie: Du entwickelst mit den PD-Heads und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO Rehan die Produkt- und Sortimentsstrategie für unsere Marken, bewertest neue Kategorien und übersetzt alles in eine klare Roadmap.

  • Product Development: Du steuerst die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Launches, challengst Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten erfolgreiche Produkte werden.

  • Sourcing & Supplier Management: Du verantwortest unsere Supplier-Landschaft, vor allem in China und Pakistan, baust eigene, belastbare Beziehungen auf und verhandelst Preise, Qualität und Timings gemeinsam mit unserem Supply Chain Team. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran.

  • Supply Chain: Du sorgst für eine stabile, effiziente Lieferkette von der Bestellung bis zur Ware im Lager und erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Performance & Zahlen: Du hast die Performance der Brands und neuer Launches im Blick, gehst in Product Deep Dives und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten.

  • Leadership: Du führst die Heads sowie die Teams aus Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality Management und ESG mit Empathie, klaren Zielen und ehrlichem Feedback. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter.

  • Krisen- & Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen.

  • Prozesse & Workflows: Du baust Strukturen, die wirklich funktionieren, und machst unseren Produktbereich skalierbar.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist Schnittstelle zu fast allen Bereichen der Gruppe, von Brand und E-Commerce über Marketplace bis Finance, und bist Sparringspartner:in für Rehan.


Dein Profil

  • Studium: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Textilmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Noch wichtiger ist uns, was du in deiner Laufbahn schon aufgebaut und bewegt hast.

  • Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche. Die Kategorie ist zweitrangig, Fashion-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. 

  • Leadership-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen.

  • Product Development: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht.

  • Sourcing & Supply Chain: Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen.

  • QM & Sustainability: Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. 

  • Strategie & Hands-on: Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Verhandlungsstärke: Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird.

  • Sourcing-Netzwerk: Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso.

  • Mindset: Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um.

  • Reisebereitschaft & Präsenz: Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan.

  • Sprachen: Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.


Warum wir?

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

  • Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu  betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.

  • Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt: Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget. 

  • Echte Flexibilität: Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.

  • Onboarding: Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.

  • Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.

  • Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun: Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.

  • Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.

  • Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!

  • Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

Verfahrensingenieur / Prozessingenieur für Wasseraufbereitungs- und Dosiertechnik (m/w/d)

Für ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Dosier-, Prozess- und Wasseraufbereitungstechnik suchen wir einen Verfahrensingenieur / Prozessingenieur (m/w/d), der technische Kundenanforderungen in maßgeschneiderte Anlagenkonzepte übersetzt.

Sie arbeiten an technisch anspruchsvollen Lösungen für Wasseraufbereitung sowie für unterschiedliche industrielle Anwendungen – unter anderem in der Chemie-, Pharma-, Lebensmittel- und Getränkeindustrie – und begleiten Ihre Projekte von der ersten technischen Idee bis zur Übergabe an die Fertigung.

Aufgaben

  • Sie entwickeln und dimensionieren kundenspezifische Anlagen für die Wasseraufbereitung, Dosierung und Behandlung fluider Medien.
  • Sie analysieren technische Anforderungen und erarbeiten daraus geeignete verfahrenstechnische Lösungen.
  • Sie erstellen Fließschemata, technische Spezifikationen und Projektdokumentationen.
  • Sie legen Komponenten und Anlagen technisch aus und wirken bei der Kalkulation von Angeboten mit.
  • Sie begleiten Projekte von der Kundenanfrage über das Engineering bis zur Übergabe an die Fertigung.
  • Bei Bedarf unterstützen Sie die Inbetriebnahme der Anlagen beim Kunden und führen technische Einweisungen bzw. Schulungen durch.
  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Vertrieb, Konstruktion, Fertigung und weiteren technischen Bereichen zusammen.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium beispielsweise in

  • Verfahrenstechnik,
  • Prozessingenieurwesen,
  • Chemieingenieurwesen,
  • Umwelttechnik,
  • Wassertechnologie

oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

Darüber hinaus bringen Sie praktische Erfahrung mit fluiden Medien und verfahrenstechnischen Prozessen mit – beispielsweise aus der Wasseraufbereitung, Dosiertechnik, chemischen Verfahrenstechnik, Prozessindustrie oder dem Anlagenbau.

Wichtig sind uns außerdem:

  • eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise,
  • Freude an der Entwicklung technischer Lösungen,
  • die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel zu koordinieren,
  • fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse,
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Sie sollten bereit sein, regelmäßig am Unternehmensstandort in Wertheim zu arbeiten.

Internationale Reisen sind kein Muss, können bei Interesse aber Bestandteil Ihrer Tätigkeit sein, beispielsweise bei Inbetriebnahmen oder technischen Projekten beim Kunden.

Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen und international tätigen Unternehmen
  • 37,5-Stunden-Woche
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Möglichkeit für einen Home-Office-Tag pro Woche
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Branchen und Anwendungen
  • kurze Wege zwischen Engineering, Vertrieb und Fertigung
  • individuelle fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • die Möglichkeit, eigene technische Ideen einzubringen und Projekte sichtbar mitzugestalten

Die Position passt besonders zu Ihnen, wenn …

… Sie nicht ausschließlich einzelne Komponenten bearbeiten möchten, sondern verstehen wollen, wie eine komplette verfahrenstechnische Anlage funktionieren muss.

… Sie gerne technische Anforderungen analysieren, Lösungen entwickeln und diese anschließend bis zur Umsetzung begleiten.

… Sie eine Position suchen, in der Verfahrenstechnik, Anlagenbau und Projektarbeit zusammenkommen.

Klingt interessant?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Gerne können wir uns zunächst auch ganz unverbindlich über die Position und das Unternehmen austauschen.

People Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
People Analytics Analyst

People Analytics Analyst

About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly.

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

The role:

Reporting to our Head of Reward, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight.

Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team.

You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion.

  • Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control.

  • Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality.

  • Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations.

  • Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity.

  • Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action.

  • Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust.

  • People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support.

  • Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation.

  • Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets.

  • Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations.

  • Strong Excel capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome.

  • Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs.

  • Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information.

  • Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools.

  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis.

  • Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data.

  • Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation.

  • Build trust together: Take ownership of data quality and delivery, follow through on commitments, exercise sound judgement and raise risks or limitations early.

  • Grow with the challenge: Stay curious, seek feedback and build analytical capability while adapting to changing priorities and new questions.

  • Succeed as one: Work collaboratively across People, Reward, Finance, Payroll and the wider business, engaging stakeholders early and focusing on shared outcomes.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve.

Role Level: 2

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d'un(e) Conseiller(e) de vente (H/F) en contrat 35H, pour rejoindre notre Appartement Aixois. Ce poste est basé à Aix-en-Provence (13).

Rattaché(e) au Directeur de l’Appartement, vos principales responsabilités seront : 

Délivrer une expérience client singulière :

  • Incarner l’esprit et le style Sezane par une présentation impeccable (respect du grooming) ;
  • Accueillir vos clients avec générosité et empathie afin de leur offrir la meilleure expérience possible ;
  • Considérer la personnalité de vos Clients afin d'identifier ses désirs ;
  • Faire découvrir la Marque et nos différents univers/ produits ;
  • Etre ambassadeur de l'omnicanalité de la Marque (appartement et web) ;
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et développer une connaissance approfondie de la Marque et des produits ;
  • Être force de proposition d’actions spécifiques pour rendre l’expérience client mémorable et unique ;
  • Traiter les réclamations et insatisfactions clients pour satisfaire et fidéliser nos clients ;
  • Connaître notre politique RSE pour répondre aux clients.

Garantir l’image de Marque : 

  • Connaître les règles de bases du merchandising Sézane ;
  • Vérifier l’étiquetage des produits sur le floor ;
  • Participer à l’implantation du merchandising et veiller à son suivi ;
  • Offrir aux clients une expérience shopping passionnante et inspirante ;
  • Suivre et maintenir le niveau commercial du point de vente ;
  • Avoir une culture mode pour être force de propositions.

Veiller au bon déroulement des Opérations : 

  • Appliquer les politiques, Standards et procédures Sézane ;
  • Encaisser et respecter les procédures liées aux opérations ;
  • Effectuer les process de traitements spécifiques (retours, échanges, réservations) ;
  • Participer à la définition des effectifs nécessaires pour répondre aux attentes clients ;
  • Garantir la bonne gestion des stocks.

  • Etre Team-player, participer à toutes les tâches annexes ;
  • Participer à la création d’un environnement positif et harmonieux pour créer une synergie de groupe ;
  • Relayer les engagements de la marque.

Requirements

  • Vous avez une première expérience réussie en prêt à porter, en hôtellerie, en restauration, en vente, en animation… ou pas encore, mais êtes animé par le relationnel client?
  • Vous avez le sens du service, une excellente présentation et une forte sensibilité mode ;
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et galvanisant ;
  •  Vous n’aimez pas vous ennuyer car vous débordez d’énergie?

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

jobs.description:
Senior SAP Consultant EWM (m/w/d)
Einleitung

Gestalte die Logistik von morgen
Du möchtest Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, ihre Logistikprozesse auf das nächste Level zu heben? Für ein modernes Beratungsunternehmen mit Fokus auf digitale Transformation und SAP-Lösungen suchen wir Persönlichkeiten, die Innovation mit Praxiserfahrung verbinden. Hier erwarten dich spannende Projekte, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ein Umfeld, das Eigeninitiative, Weiterentwicklung und Teamgeist fördert.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst, konzipierst und optimierst End-to-End-Logistikprozesse mit Schwerpunkt SAP EWM.
  • Du begleitest nationale und internationale Kunden bei Einführungs-, Transformations- und Betreuungsprojekten.
  • Du berätst bei der Auswahl, Konzeption und Umsetzung zukunftsfähiger Lager- und Logistiklösungen.
  • Du führst Customizing-Anpassungen durch und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze für komplexe Anforderungen.
  • Du planst und moderierst Workshops sowie Schulungen für Key User und Fachbereiche.
  • Du erarbeitest Teststrategien und begleitest Integrations-, Abnahme- und Performance-Tests.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte und steuerst diese eigenständig.
