jobs.title: Senior ICT System Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior ICT System Engineer (m/w/d)
Deine Rolle als ICT System Engineer

Als erfahrener ICT System Engineer bist du ein essenzieller Teil unseres Teams. Du planst, realisierst und optimierst moderne ICT-Plattformen und stellst deren sicheren, stabilen und leistungsfähigen Betrieb sicher. Mit deinem technischen Know-how, deinem Blick für das Gesamtsystem und deiner lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise entwickelst du nachhaltige Infrastrukturlösungen für unsere Kunden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du designst, implementierst und betreibst komplexe System- und Plattformarchitekturen in On-Premises-, Cloud- und hybriden Umgebungen.
  • Du automatisierst Provisionierung, Konfiguration und Betrieb von Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure-as-Code und Configuration-Management-Tools wie Terraform, Ansible oder PowerShell.
  • Du entwickelst Skripte, Tools und Automatisierungen zur Standardisierung von Deployments, Betriebsprozessen und wiederkehrenden Engineering-Aufgaben.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst CI/CD-Pipelines für Infrastruktur-, Plattform- und Applikationskomponenten.
  • Du betreibst und optimierst virtualisierte und containerisierte Umgebungen, beispielsweise mit VMware, Hyper-V, Docker und Kubernetes.
  • Du integrierst Server-, Netzwerk-, Storage-, Identity- und Security-Komponenten zu stabilen und skalierbaren Gesamtsystemen.
  • Du konzipierst technische Lösungen für Netzwerksegmentierung, DNS, Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies, Firewalls, VPN und sichere Systemkommunikation.
  • Du implementierst Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen und nutzt Metriken, Logs und Traces zur Analyse komplexer Systemzustände.
  • Du analysierst Performance-Probleme, Netzwerkfehler, Ressourcenengpässe und komplexe Incidents bis auf Betriebssystem-, Netzwerk- oder Applikationsebene.
  • Du planst und realisierst Migrationen, Plattform-Upgrades, Systemablösungen und Cloud-Transformationen.
  • Du entwickelst technische Standards und Referenzarchitekturen für wiederverwendbare und automatisierbare Plattformen.
  • Du dokumentierst Architekturen, Konfigurationen, Abhängigkeiten, Betriebsprozesse und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und praxisnah.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Software Engineers, Security Engineers, Architekten und Kundenteams zusammen und übernimmst bei Bedarf die technische Führung innerhalb eines Projekts.


Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als System Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Server-Betriebssystem-Stack, beispielsweise Linux oder Windows Server.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, Firewalls, Load Balancing und grundlegenden Netzwerkarchitekturen.
  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungsplattformen wie VMware vSphere, Hyper-V oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer Public-Cloud-Plattform wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud.
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code, beispielsweise Terraform, sowie mit Konfigurationsautomatisierung über Ansible, PowerShell, Bash oder vergleichbare Technologien.
  • Gute Scripting- oder Programmierkenntnisse, beispielsweise in PowerShell, Python, Bash oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache.
  • Erfahrung mit Git-basierten Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Workflows.
  • Verständnis moderner CI/CD-Prozesse und Erfahrung mit Plattformen wie GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder Jenkins.
  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb und Troubleshooting produktiver ICT-Systeme mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Nachvollziehbarkeit.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Identity & Access Management, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, Secrets Management und grundlegenden Security-Prinzipien.
  • Erfahrung mit Backup-, Restore- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten und deren technischer Umsetzung.
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Fehler systematisch einzugrenzen und Probleme über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg zu analysieren.
  • Ein ausgeprägter Engineering-Mindset: Du automatisierst repetitive Arbeit, bevorzugst reproduzierbare Konfigurationen und behandelst Infrastruktur möglichst als Code.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute technische Englischkenntnisse.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und dem produktiven Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen.
  • Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Komponenten und -Ökosystemen wie Helm, Ingress Controller, Operators oder GitOps.
  • Kenntnisse mit GitOps-Werkzeugen wie Argo CD oder Flux.
  • Erfahrung mit Observability-Stacks wie Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elastic Stack oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • Erfahrung mit zentralem Log Management und SIEM-Plattformen.
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure, beispielsweise Entra ID, Azure Networking, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Monitor oder Azure Policy.
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-365-, Active-Directory- oder Entra-ID-Integrationen.
  • Erfahrung mit hybriden Identity-, Netzwerk- und Cloud-Architekturen.
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich PKI, Zertifikatsmanagement und Secrets Management, beispielsweise mit HashiCorp Vault oder Cloud-nativen Key-Management-Systemen.
  • Erfahrung mit API Gateways, Reverse Proxies und Webservern wie nginx, Traefik oder HAProxy.
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Software Development und Erfahrung beim Entwickeln kleiner interner Services, APIs oder Plattform-Tools.
  • Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, Message Queues oder verteilten Systemen.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Client Onboarding Specialist

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview:

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You bring a proactive approach to addressing challenges, empathy, and problem-solving skills to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

What You Do Each Day:

  • Own relationship during initial onboarding phase for new Pros including account activation and transition, adoption and product utilization, relationship building, and delivery of product and service value
  • Serve as the primary and dedicated resource for Pros during their early lifecycle, ensuring a smooth transition from sales through onboarding
  • Reinforce and “resell” the value of HCP, helping Pros build confidence in their decision and driving early product adoption
  • Effectively communicate client information, trends, and feedback across teams (i.e. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Tech Support)
  • Partner cross-functionally to support Pro success, especially collaborating with Account Managers to mitigate risk, drive retention, and ensure long-term growth
  • Develop, prepare, and nurture our Pros for advocacy, using a consultative and empathetic approach
  • Identify opportunities for expansion, recommend areas for improvement, and proactively look for ways to better our Pros experience
  • Manage details, timelines, and action to drive efficiency
  • Improve our Pros opportunities by leveraging qualitative and quantitative analysis
  • Develop processes that distinguish our brand by exceeding customer expectations in support delivery
  • Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions

Qualifications:

  • 1-3+ years experience in full-time customer success, implementation or sales
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
  • Proven success in developing relationships with new customers and exceeding success metrics
  • Ability to work the scheduled shifts: Monday - Friday 11am-8pm PST
  • Advanced English proficiency

What Will Help You Succeed:

  • Self-starter with motivation, drive, and ability to work in a fast paced environment
  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prompt attention to detail
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Experience using AI tools to increase quality and efficiency of work
  • A natural curiosity backed by action; you are multi-dimensional (volunteering, creative outlets, side projects, hobbies, athletics), with a proven ability to successfully start over, learn from scratch, and thrive in new environments

Location Dependent Information

This role is open to candidates and the expected compensation range for this role is $25,450-$28,500 annual OTE (includes range of $19,750-$22,800 base plus variable bonus). The specific rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden

  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich

We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

We’re looking for an accountant who wants to be a builder—whether you’ve already moved into a client-facing/solutions role or you’re a current accountant ready to apply your craft with modern tools. Having previous professional accounting or audit experience will allow the candidate to build immediate trust with our customers.

You’ll own the long-term relationship with our customers after sales and implementation, partnering with CFOs, Controllers, and Accounting Managers to deliver scalable, automated solutions on Rillet’s AI platform. If you enjoy solving complex accounting problems, client interaction, system configuration, and measurable impact—but don’t have a traditional “Customer Success” background—this role is for you.

Life at Rillet

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

You will join the Foundations team, who build the data systems that enable frontier robotics labs to generate, understand, train, and test on massive volumes of robotics data. We don’t just react to an order book tick - you will need to handle large 3D scenes, hour-long videos, LIDAR point clouds, and ML inference, all under tight performance and operational budgets.

Why now? A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 180 and still accelerating. You'll work directly with a high-bar team, take on high-stakes problems, and help shape where the platform goes next.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, deploy and own data systems processing petabytes of data across billions of items, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Design performant protocols and APIs, and tackle complex domains and immense scale with correct and pragmatic solutions, moving extremely fast while maintaining engineering quality.

  • Build as part of a high-performing team, contribute your knowledge and experience to others.

Who you are

You will have excelled at something demanding, and can show that your good technical decisions day after day compounded into a competitive edge.

Experience with large data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus.

The Applied Machine Learning team owns production systems and pursues new ideas, from conception and prototyping through to deployment, evaluation and iterative improvement.

Working with clinicians, assessors and engineers, we build reliable ML systems that help bring medical devices to market faster, without compromising safety. It’s a domain rich in text, data and expert judgment, with little precedent for much of what we’re building.

You’ll own meaningful problems in how we assess medical devices: define success with domain experts, decide what to build and test, and take ML systems through deployment and measurable improvement in production.

Things you might work on:

  • Evals wired into real workflows – Define success with assessors and build datasets and benchmarks that capture a complex, nuanced domain. Measure retrieval quality, citation correctness and agreement with expert judgment alongside the impact on assessor effort, assessment quality and customer experience, including rework. Use the results to choose what to improve next.

  • Applied AI alignment – Build useful agents that respect the impartiality and objectivity required of a certification body. Help people understand the evidence, recognise uncertainty and retain responsibility for consequential judgments.

Who you are

  • Creator of datasets – You roll up your sleeves and build the dataset you wish existed, rather than wait for someone else to give you one.

  • Establisher of evals – You think from first principles about statistics and evaluating ML systems. You're suspicious of benchmarks that don't match reality.

  • Shipper of software – 3+ years shipping software to production. You own deployment, monitoring and the investigation when something breaks.

  • Hacker – You take ambitious projects from concept to reality with whatever tools are at hand. You experiment, measure and change your mind.

  • Builder – You're insatiably curious about real-world problems and care that what you build has clear economic and human value.

  • Owner of ambiguous problems – You can point to an ambiguous problem you owned: working directly with domain experts to define success, choosing what to try, and following it through experiments and production to measurable improvement.

Preferred qualifications

jobs.title: Managing Director - France
jobs.description:
Managing Director - France

Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

Analytics Engineer

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


➡️ Mission: Join us as Analytics Engineer x Business Analytics and become the person our Business Analytics teams can build on without a second thought.

You will own end-to-end the data models feeding Product, Growth, and Ops Finance analytics — designing scalable dbt models, pushing back on requests that would trade reliability for speed, and helping the team migrate to Omni and a real semantic layer.

You will work closely with Jules Jeanroy, our Analytics Engineering Manager, and partner daily with Business Analysts across Product, Growth, and Ops Finance. The team is at a pivotal moment — investing in scalability, cutting technical debt, and building the standards that will define how Analytics Engineering works at Qonto for years to come.

➡️ As an Analytics Engineer at Qonto, you will:

  • Build data models Business Analytics teams trust — design and ship dbt models and tests that hold up under real, everyday use across Product, Growth, and Ops Finance
  • Partner with Business Analysts, not just execute for them — understand what they actually need, and push back when a request would trade long-term reliability for a quick fix
  • Reduce technical debt at scale — help migrate parts of the data stack to a more scalable setup, including our ongoing move to Omni
  • Own your projects end-to-end — take work from discovery through delivery, and follow up on its real impact instead of just closing a ticket
  • Scale your own workflow with AI — use AI tools to speed up documentation, testing, and modeling work, while keeping the judgment calls in your hands

➡️ What you can expect:

  • Join at a pivotal moment — the team is scaling and migrating to Omni; you're helping shape what comes next, not just maintaining what already exists
  • Room to move — grow horizontally across Business Analytics, Compliance, and Foundation scopes, or work toward mentoring and standards ownership within the BA team as a senior profile
  • Business partnering is core, not incidental — you'll work daily with Product, Growth, and Ops Finance stakeholders; challenging a request without damaging the relationship matters as much as your technical chops
  • AI is the multiplier — we use AI daily at Qonto (read our vision); we expect you to use it too, not just as a coding assistant but to speed up modeling, documentation, and testing

➡️ About your future manager: Your manager will be Jules Jeanroy, our Analytics Engineering Manager.

Jules joined Qonto in March 2026 to lead the Analytics Engineering team that partners with Business Analysts. He focuses on strengthening the way Analytics Engineers and Business Analysts work together, building reliable, high-quality data foundations, and scaling data practices as Qonto grows. Before Qonto, he worked as Lead Analytics Engineer at Spendesk and as a BI Engineer at Brevo, back in the pre-dbt world. His leadership style is direct and collaborative. You can hear him talk about Analytics Engineering in French in this podcast.

➡️ About You

  • Analytics Engineering fundamentals — you're strong in dbt and SQL, especially dimensional modeling; you've shipped production-grade models other teams build dashboards on top of
  • Comfortable pushing back — you know how to challenge a stakeholder request that would hurt data quality, without shutting down the relationship
  • Built for scale, not just speed — you design models that hold up months later, and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later"
  • AI-native work style — you use AI tools beyond just chatting, to speed up modeling, documentation, or test generation
  • Appetite for ownership — you're ready to take projects end-to-end, and, if senior, to help raise the team's standards too
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, GTM Strategy
jobs.description:
Director, Product Marketing, GTM Strategy

A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is entering an exciting new phase of growth. We've built innovative products across Maintenance, Fleet Intelligence, and our ecosystem, but product innovation alone isn't enough. Our next stage of growth depends on how effectively we commercialize those innovations and translate them into customer value, adoption, and revenue.

As the Director of Product Marketing, GTM Strategy, you'll build the operating system that connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships around bringing products to market.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on role responsible for creating the messaging, frameworks, sales plays, commercialization processes, and GTM operating rhythms that help Fleetio consistently launch, sell, and grow new products.

You’ll build the function from the ground up, and grow and lead a team focused on commercialization, GTM programs, and sales enablement.

Who you are

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller, operator, and builder.

You love turning complex products into simple customer stories that help sales teams win. You think beyond launches—you think about commercialization, adoption, pipeline, and revenue. You understand that great product marketing isn't about creating more assets. It's about building systems.

You've partnered closely with Product, Sales, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership to define positioning, create value messaging, develop repeatable sales motions, and improve how products reach the market.

You're comfortable creating the strategy yourself while also building the playbooks, messaging, presentations, and processes needed to make it real.

Most importantly, you're excited about building a function that doesn't exist today.

Your impact

GTM Strategy & Commercialization

  • Create repeatable frameworks that consistently bring new products to market.
  • Develop commercialization plans that align Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Partner with Product leadership to ensure commercialization begins early in the product lifecycle, not at launch.
  • Establish scalable launch readiness processes that support both major launches and continuous product innovation.
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies alongside Product, Finance, and Leadership.

Messaging, Positioning & Value Selling

  • Own Fleetio's corporate messaging framework and customer value narrative.
  • Develop positioning that shifts conversations from product features to business outcomes.
  • Create messaging frameworks for company, platform, products, industries, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build the First Call Deck and other foundational sales messaging used across the organization.
  • Develop solution narratives for key growth areas including Maintenance, AI, Fleet Intelligence, Telematics, and Partnerships.
  • Ensure messaging remains consistent across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Executive communications.

Sales Plays & Enablement

  • Build repeatable sales plays that help Sales create pipeline and win deals.
  • Partner closely with Sales Enablement to develop playbooks, talk tracks, discovery guides, objection handling, and value-selling content.
  • Integrate messaging into MEDDPICC and other sales methodologies.
  • Develop vertical messaging and industry-specific sales assets.
  • Build and maintain a centralized repository of GTM messaging, presentations, and commercialization assets.
  • Partner with field teams to continuously improve materials based on customer feedback.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership.
  • Build repeatable GTM planning rhythms across organizations.
  • Help teams align around priorities, milestones, launch plans, and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Demand Generation to ensure campaigns reinforce Fleetio's value narrative.
  • Support partner commercialization through joint messaging, enablement, and go-to-market programs.

Building the Function

  • Establish the commercialization function at Fleetio.
  • Define operating processes, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to scale through AI, automation, and repeatable systems.
  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing commercialization team as Fleetio grows.
  • Create an environment focused on experimentation, learning, ownership, and measurable business impact.

Your experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Go-to-Market Strategy, Commercialization, or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS.
  • Experience building commercialization, product marketing, or GTM programs from the ground up.
  • Strong expertise in positioning, messaging, value frameworks, and sales enablement.
  • Experience partnering directly with executive leadership, Product, Sales, Enablement, and Marketing.
  • Proven ability to translate product innovation into commercial success.
  • Experience creating repeatable GTM operating models and launch processes.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong, Highspot (or similar), Notion, AI productivity tools, and modern GTM technology.
  • A builder's mindset—you enjoy creating structure where none exists and scaling teams over time.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

jobs.title: Payments Solutions Architect (US or EMEA)
jobs.description:
Payments Solutions Architect (US or EMEA)

Location: This is a 100% remote role open to candidates residing in the Eastern United States or EMEA region.

About the job

Testlio's fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology - LeoCore™, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit testlio.com.

An exciting growth frontier for Testlio is digital payments and financial transactions. We are hiring a visionary and hands-on Payments Solutions Architect to lead the intersection of digital financial transactions and quality engineering. This role brings together deep practitioner expertise and strategic business leadership. You will define, package, and oversee the quality of our payments testing offerings—establishing the catalog, methodology, staffing, and pricing—while diving deep into the technical architecture of complex transaction systems to solve quality engineering roadblocks. You will imagine and drive innovative strategies to expand our payments business while delivering exceptional, hands-on value across our client portfolio.

Why you will love this job?

  • Blend Strategy with Technical Depth: Drive the overarching vision and commercial packaging of our Payments offerings while staying grounded in the technical architecture and delivery methodologies.
  • Shape the future of Payments Testing: Be at the forefront of innovation, building and evangelizing solutions that drive transaction integrity and quality across enterprise-level, global clients. Speak at conferences, author papers, collaborate with partners.
  • Partner with clients to solve complex challenges: Work directly with clients on deep technical integrations and architectural setups to shape testing strategies that deliver measurable value.
  • Make a tangible impact: Your work directly influences the success of our clients and the quality of their digital products. See your contributions translated into real-world improvements that benefit millions of users.
  • Drive company influence: Help build the pipeline, join sales calls and guide delivery on Payments opportunities, bringing your expertise to high-impact business decisions.

Why you will love being a part of Testlio?

  • Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
  • Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
  • Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.
  • Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio.

What would your day look like?

Strategic & Commercial Responsibilities

  • Vision Activation & Marketing: Imagine, drive, evangelize, and activate a viewpoint on the future of Payments Testing. Produce white papers, articles, posts, speeches, and webinars.
  • Ecosystem & Alliances Support: Collaborate with the Testlio VP, Alliances and external software partners to identify and execute joint GTM offerings with payments and commerce consultancies.
  • Sales Collaboration: Engage with enterprise-class prospects in partnership with Testlio Sales. Provide authentic and clear guidance on effective Payments Testing strategies, tactics, and ROI.
  • Offering Lifecycle Management: Launch, evolve, and refine payments services, based on market and competitive intelligence.

Collaboration on Hands-on Delivery

  • Architectural Design: Dive deep into client digital transaction architectures to design bespoke, highly technical quality engineering methodologies for agentic payments, mobile payments, wallets, and POS systems.
  • Delivery Expertise: Act as an escalation point and subject-matter expert for Delivery, stepping in hands-on from scoping to test execution review on complex or strategic payments engagements.
  • Technical Problem Solving: Solve technical roadblocks in payments quality engineering, ensuring transaction integrity, security, and compliance across different global regions and instruments.
  • Client Up-Leveling: Dive into intellectually stimulating, and 100M+ user scale-impacting work. Help Testlio Services teams and top clients see, design, and implement new technical approaches.

What do you need to succeed?

Technical Skills

  • Deep Payments Experience: 10+ years of deep experience with digital payment systems, including mobile payments, online banking, payment gateways, wallets, and point-of-sale systems.
  • Quality Engineering Affinity: Strong technical affinity for quality engineering, API integrations, and world-class software development methodologies within the financial sector.
  • Hands-on Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to dive into the technical architecture, troubleshoot payment integrations, and design structured evaluation criteria for complex transaction flows.
  • Education: Master's degree in Finance, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Human Skills

  • Proven Client-Facing Experience: Strong management consulting or managed services background with a client-centric mindset and ability to lead technical discovery.
  • Commercial & Strategic Acumen: Experience designing service offerings, understanding cost-to-serve dynamics, and collaborating cross-functionally across sales and partners.
  • Systems Thinker: Keen intellect, vivid imagination, and rapid problem-solving capabilities, paired with a "lifetime learner" approach to functional application.
  • Communication: Excellent written, visual, and oral communication capabilities enabling clear message delivery and active listening to both technical teams and business executives.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership ability to motivate and inspire distributed cross-functional teams without direct people management burden.

What is the application process?

At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. Because we are a fully distributed company, our interview process includes conversations with several team members so you can get a well-rounded understanding of the role, the people you’ll work with, and how we collaborate. As a result, our interview process typically takes 3–4 weeks to complete.

Interview Process:

  • Application
  • Recruiter interview
  • TestGorilla assessment
  • ~ 3 Team and Stakeholder interviews
  • Reference checks
  • Offer & background check

Diversity and Inclusion

Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and half of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website.

jobs.title: Technical SAP Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Technical SAP Product Owner (m/w/d)

Als Technical SAP Product Owner (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Weiterentwicklung unseres Natuvion DCS Produktportfolios. Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern, Partnern, Kunden sowie funktionsübergreifenden Delivery-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte echten Mehrwert schaffen und Natuvion strategisch voranbringen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Verantwortung für die Produktvision, Strategie und Zielerreichung eines oder mehrerer Produkte innerhalb des Natuvion DCS Portfolios rund um den Themenkomplex SAP Datenmigration & -transformation (inkl. Anonymisierung, Validierung und Vervielfältigung von Daten)

  • Definition, Verwaltung und Priorisierung des Product Backlogs mit starkem Fokus auf Kundennutzen und Business Impact

  • Zentrale Ansprechperson für Service Owner, Kunden, funktionsübergreifende Delivery-Teams, Vertrieb, Marketing und Partnerunternehmen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Technical Lead, um Prioritäten in skalierbare, qualitativ hochwertige und technisch umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen

  • Aufbereitung von Initiativen in Epics und User Stories sowie Anforderungsklärung in Zusammenarbeit mit technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern

  • Sicherstellen, dass Backlog‑Items der Definition of Ready entsprechen und ausgelieferte Features die Definition of Done erfüllen

  • Interne und externe Repräsentation des Produkts sowie selbstbewusste Kommunikation von Fortschritten, Prioritäten und Ergebnissen


Dein Profil:

  • Studium der (Wirtschafts‑) Informatik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im SAP/ABAP‑Umfeld, idealerweise mit praktischem Entwicklungs‑Background

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Product Thinking, Backlog‑Management, Requirements Engineering und Priorisierung

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, zwischen fachlichen und technischen Perspektiven zu vermitteln

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit analytischem, lösungsorientiertem Denken

  • Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Erfahrungen als Product Owner oder Technical Lead von Vorteil

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Falls du denkst, dass du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst: Bei uns sind deiner Entwicklung „keine Grenzen gesetzt“! Geh mit uns gemeinsam deinen Weg – Wir unterstützen dich dabei! Zeige uns einfach wer du bist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Umfeld, dass jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandenen Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne!

Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst:

  • Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit 

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub 

  • FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten 

  • Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen 

  • Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion 

  • Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung 

  • Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen 

  • Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig  

  • Uns ist deine langfristige Perspektive wichtig, deshalb bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen 

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion ist ein digitales Umzugsunternehmen.

Unser Team bewegt keine Tische, Aktenschränke oder Stühle. Natuvion transportiert geschäftskritische Daten und Prozesse von einer Technologieplattform auf eine andere. Typische Natuvion „Umzugsdienstleistungen“ umfassen Datenmigration, Datentransformation, Datenintegration, Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Datenqualität.

Unsere >400 BeraterInnen und EntwicklerInnen in Deutschland, Österreich, Slowakei, USA und Australien verfügen über weitreichendes Knowhow bei (SAP®-)Projekten und ein profundes Prozessverständnis über Branchengrenzen hinweg. Mit viel Erfahrung, Engagement und Einsatz begleiten sie unsere Kunden mit Beratung, Dienstleistung und eigener Softwaretechnologie. So ermöglichen wir Unternehmen, ihre Daten und Prozesse immer auf den modernsten und innovativsten Plattformen zu nutzen.

jobs.title: Senior AWS Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior AWS Consultant (m/w/d)

Du möchtest Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg in die Cloud begleiten und dabei moderne AWS-Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert entwickeln? Als Senior Consultant AWS (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Kunden bei der Umsetzung ihrer Cloud-Strategien und bringst dein Know-how dort ein, wo du die größte Wirkung erzielen kannst. Dabei musst du nicht alles können: Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt bewegst du dich in einem oder mehreren unserer strategischen AWS-Fokusthemen.


Was du bei uns machst

• Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung moderner AWS-Lösungen
• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Architekturen und anspruchsvolle Cloud-Projekte
• Du bringst deine Expertise in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche ein:
• Migration & Modernisation: Du begleitest Cloud-Migrationen und modernisierst bestehende Anwendungslandschaften
• Data & AI: Du entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungen und unterstützt bei Analytics-, AI- und Machine-Learning-Projekten
• Security: Du konzipierst sichere Cloud-Architekturen und unterstützt bei Security-, Compliance- und Governance-Anforderungen
• Engineering: Du automatisierst Cloud-Plattformen, setzt Infrastructure as Code um und entwickelst skalierbare AWS-Umgebungen
• Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und begleitest Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung


Wann du zu uns passt

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Cloud-Lösungen auf Basis von AWS
• Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem unserer Fokusbereiche Migration & Modernisation, Data & AI, Security oder Engineering mit.
• Du verstehst es, technische Herausforderungen in nachhaltige und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
• Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein.
• Erfahrung mit Cloud-native Architekturen, Automatisierung, DevOps oder modernen Datenplattformen ist von Vorteil.
• Idealerweise verfügst du über relevante AWS-Zertifizierungen oder hast Interesse, diese gemeinsam mit uns zu erwerben.
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
 

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. 

 
Was du von uns hast

Das Unternehmen

Die Bendl Investment GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Multi Family Office und Vermögensverwaltung mit Sitz in Erding. Wir betreuen Unternehmer, Führungskräfte, Erben und vermögende Familien in den Bereichen Vermögensanlage, Altersvorsorge, Absicherung und langfristige Finanzplanung.

jobs.title: Praktikum Logistik & Supply Chain Strategie (m/w/d)
Praktikum Logistik & Data Analytics (m/w/d)
Associate Account Executive, High Growth (Financial Services)
Lead Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Lead Security Engineer

About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

About the role

We're looking for a Lead Security Engineer to own and mature how Encord secures its people, identities, devices, and the SaaS and AI tools we run the business on. You'll be hands-on, building and running controls yourself, while also owning the organisation security programme and acting as the go-to security expert across the company.

You'll play a key role in protecting our leadership team from targeted attacks, serve as the technical backbone of our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 programmes, and partner with our DevOps and Platform teams on cloud security. Above all, you'll help us stay safe while keeping our pace.

What you'll do

  • Own identity and access across Encord, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, and automated joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Manage our device security, keeping our macOS fleet protected through MDM and EDR.

  • Run SaaS and AI security: discovering shadow IT, reviewing app permissions, assessing new tools before adoption, and setting sensible guardrails for how AI tools are used.

  • Protect our executives and high-risk users from targeted phishing, impersonation, business email compromise, and AI-enabled fraud such as deepfakes.

  • Act as the technical owner of our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, from policies and evidence through to auditor walkthroughs.

  • Lead third-party and vendor risk assessments.

  • Respond to and lead security incidents, and continuously improve how we detect and handle them.

  • Partner with DevOps and Platform to secure our cloud environment.

  • Write clear policies and runbooks, and roll out changes in a way that keeps the employee experience smooth.

What you'll bring

  • Around 7–8 years of hands-on security experience, with a strong focus on organisation security.

  • Experience rolling out or re-architecting SSO, MFA, and conditional access across a company.

  • Experience deploying and managing MDM and EDR across a macOS fleet.

  • A track record of building automated joiner/mover/leaver flows and user access reviews.

  • Experience running SaaS security, including discovering shadow IT, reviewing app permissions, and assessing new tools before adoption.

  • Experience putting guardrails around AI tool usage, such as approved tool lists, data handling rules, and vendor reviews of AI providers.

  • Ownership of, or significant contribution to, ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 audits, including policies, control evidence, and auditor walkthroughs.

  • Experience defending against targeted phishing ("whaling") and business email compromise, such as fake CEO payment requests, invoice fraud, and gift card scams.

  • Experience leading or supporting security incidents such as phishing compromises, account takeovers, or lost devices.

  • Experience running third-party and vendor risk assessments and advising on the security of new tools before they're adopted.

  • Experience partnering with DevOps/Platform teams to secure cloud environments (ideally GCP), including IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, logging, and CSPM.

  • A habit of writing policies and runbooks that people can easily follow.

  • A thoughtful approach to change: you've rolled out new controls with clear communication, phased approaches, and a focus on keeping the employee experience smooth.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g. Terraform).

  • Experience owning vulnerability management across infrastructure, including scanning, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and SLAs.

  • Experience building and improving detection and monitoring, centralising logs into a SIEM and defining meaningful alerts.

  • Experience implementing and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience coordinating external penetration tests and bug reports, and driving fixes to closure with engineering teams.

  • Experience helping engineers write secure code through guidance, patterns, and lightweight training.

  • Experience supporting sales and customer trust by answering security questionnaires and joining customer security calls.

  • Familiarity with executive digital protection, such as OSINT footprint reviews, impersonation monitoring, and out-of-band verification for sensitive requests.


Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Solutions Engineer

About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

As a Solutions Engineer at Encord, you will be the core technical expert and problem-solver for our most complex customers. You are the engineering-focused counterpart to the commercial team, partnering with Account Executives to architect and implement solutions for prospects on the cutting-edge of AI.

You will be the expert on how our platform integrates and scales, establishing technical credibility and guiding prospects through complex evaluations, especially for applications in robotics, autonomous systems, and multimodal AI. You are both a deep technical builder and an expert business value translator.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Account Executives and the ML team to lead the technical strategy for complex, enterprise sales cycles and co-own the technical win

  • Lead deep technical discovery sessions with a wide range of stakeholders (from ML Engineers to MLOps leaders) to not only uncover business pain but to architect a complete technical solution and integration path

  • Architect, build, and deliver highly-technical, customised product demonstrations and proof-of-concepts (POCs) that solve specific, complex customer problems

  • Own the end-to-end technical implementation of POCs, writing robust, production-quality Python scripts for complex data ingestion, pre/post-processing, dataset management, and custom platform integrations

  • Act as the key technical advisor to prospects, expertly guiding them through security, architecture, and integration evaluations, particularly on complex data pipelines involving multimodal data, LiDAR, or robotics sensor data

  • Translate complex technical architectures and findings into clear, persuasive value propositions for senior, non-technical stakeholders (Directors, VPs, CTOs)

  • Serve as the "voice of the customer" to our Product and Engineering teams, channelling detailed, technical feedback from complex enterprise clients to help shape the product roadmap

Who we're looking for

  • Coding experience — hands-on experience building and debugging scripts and solutions using Python or other scripting languages; experience with SDKs is desirable

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can confidently command a room of engineers and just as easily simplify complex concepts for senior decision-makers

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.

Role Overview

As a Lead Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sales strategic relationship, retention, and value realization across our highest-stakes enterprise accounts. You are a self-starter and bar-raiser who operates with high autonomy, driving customer outcomes while working in tight partnership with Sales to uncover and capitalize on strategic growth opportunities.

You will bridge complex technical deployments with executive-level business goals, ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment and naturally expand their footprint with us.

  • Drive Strategic Account Value & Retention: Accountable for net retention, customer health, and long-term strategic alignment across a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts.
  • Partner with Sales for Account Growth: Work side-by-side with Account Executives/Strategic Account Managers to identify expansion vectors, co-develop account plans, and position new capabilities that directly support the customer's technical roadmap.
  • Integrate with Technical Counterparts: Partner closely with Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and technical leads to ensure technical delivery aligns directly with the client's business outcomes, removing friction and accelerating time-to-value.
  • Operate as an Independent Bar-Raiser: Proactively build scalable Customer Success playbooks, elevate executive engagement standards, and operate with extreme ownership without needing step-by-step guidance.
  • Cultivate C-Suite & Technical Sponsorship: Build multi-threaded relationships across business and technology functions (CIO, CISO, CTO, VPs of Engineering, Product Leads) to ensure continuous alignment with top corporate initiatives.
  • Drive Business Outcomes & QBRs: Shift client conversations from product usage to business impact, leading executive business reviews (EBRs/QBRs) that demonstrate clear ROI and anchor the account for long-term growth.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Post-Sales Strategic Track Record: 10+ years in Enterprise Customer Success, Account Management, or Technical Account Management handling high-ARR, complex enterprise platforms.
  • Commercial Acumen & Growth Mindset: Proven history of partnering with Sales to identify, nurture, and help close upsells, expansions, and renewals in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Technical & FDE Alignment: Deep experience collaborating with Forward-Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, and product delivery teams to translate technical achievements into commercial value.
  • High Autonomy & Leadership: Self-motivated bar-raiser with a bias for action who excels in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and takes full accountability for account outcomes.
  • Executive Presence: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with a track record of challenging and advising C-level executives on technology strategy and operational efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses

  • High Tech Industry Expertise: Domain knowledge in High Tech (e.g., cloud native, hardware/software OEMs, or AI/ML platforms) and an understanding of how engineering-led enterprises operate and scale.

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

  • Month 3: Fully onboarded, account health assessments completed, and tight alignment established with assigned Sales AEs and FDE teams on key accounts.
  • Month 6: Value-realization frameworks and executive cadence active across all accounts, with clear expansion pipelines co-developed alongside Sales.
  • Month 12: High Net Retention Rate (NRR) achieved across the portfolio, demonstrable business outcomes delivered with FDEs, and elevated CS playbooks established as standard practice for the broader team.

Target Annual Earnings (salary + commission): $190K-220K OTE
